shared_anchors: Detective Tyler Horstman of the St. Lucie County Sheriff's Office
March 2 off-duty crash in Vero Beach while driving a sheriff's office vehicle
October 26 surrender at the Indian River County Jail on a felony DUI charge involving serious injury
Reported blood-alcohol concentration of 0.246
Criminal investigation led by the Vero Beach Police Department
novel_facts: Jail records show Horstman was released Monday evening after posting $15,000 bond.
